modules.title: Introduction to The Rightly Guided Caliphs
modules.html:
Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman and Ali: their election, achievements and contributions to Islam. This section covers introduction to the rightly guided caliphs.

Key points

  • The 'Rightly Guided Caliphs' are known in Arabic as... — Khulafa' ar-Rashidun.
  • The four Caliphs are collectively known as the — Khulafa ar-Rashidun.

Worked examples

Q: The 'Rightly Guided Caliphs' are known in Arabic as...
A: Khulafa' ar-Rashidun — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Khulafa' ar-Rashidun.

Q: The four Caliphs are collectively known as the?
A: Khulafa ar-Rashidun — Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Khulafa ar-Rashidun.

More key points

  • The 'Rightly Guided Caliphs' are known in Arabic as... — Khulafa' ar-Rashidun.
  • The four Caliphs are collectively known as the — Khulafa ar-Rashidun.

quiz.q: The 'Rightly Guided Caliphs' are known in Arabic as...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Khulafa' ar-Rashidun.

quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Khulafa ar-Rashidun.

quiz.q: The most important rite of Hajj is the standing at?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Arafat.

quiz.q: The migration of the early Muslims from Makkah to Abyssinia (Ethiopia) was to escape the persecution of the _____.
quiz.solution: The Quraysh polytheists persecuted early converts, prompting the Prophet to advise some to seek refuge with the Christian King Negus (Najashi).

quiz.q: The amount of Zakat payable on wealth (gold/silver/cash) that has reached the Nisab is _____.
quiz.solution: Zakat on liquid assets is calculated at 2.5% (one-fortieth) of the total value once held for a full lunar year.

quiz.q: The 'Nisab' of cattle (cows) for Zakat starts at _____ animals.
quiz.solution: Zakat is not due on cows until the owner has at least 30, at which point one one-year-old calf (Tabi') is due.

quiz.q: The treaty signed between the Muslims and the Quraysh in 628 CE was the Treaty of _____.
quiz.solution: Hudaibiyyah was a 10-year peace treaty that, although initially seeming disadvantageous to Muslims, led to the peaceful conquest of Makkah.

quiz.q: The major theme of the 'Makkan' Surahs is usually _____.
quiz.solution: Makkan Surahs focus on establishing faith, the oneness of Allah, and the reality of life after death, while Madinan Surahs focus on law and community building.

quiz.q: The 'Riddah' wars were fought during the Caliphate of Abu Bakr against _____.
quiz.solution: After the Prophet's death, some tribes rebelled or followed false prophets like Musaylimah; Abu Bakr fought to maintain the unity of Islam.

quiz.q: The 'Asadullah' (Lion of Allah) was a title of _____.
quiz.solution: The Prophet's uncle, Hamzah, was given this title for his bravery, though Ali (RA) was also famously brave.

quiz.q: The amount of Zakat payable on wealth (gold/cash) that has reached the Nisab is _____.
quiz.solution: Zakat on liquid assets is calculated at 2.5% (one-fortieth) of the total savings held for a full lunar year.

quiz.q: The companion who was the father of Aishah (RA) was _____.
quiz.solution: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq was the Prophet's closest friend and father of his wife Aishah.

quiz.q: Revealed in:
